context.title: Project Context
context.ecosystemQVMD:
As part of an apprenticeship within the Blue Soft Group, I work in multi-project mode following agile methodology (SCRUM type) either in TMA or in the form of 1 or 2 week sprints depending on the project.

The organizational processes are part of a DevOps approach.

Ecosystem is a public authority-approved eco-organization. Its objective is to connect professionals in order to promote the recycling and donation of all types of waste through the organization of collection.

This operation thus allows materials to be revalued by finding them a use and giving them a second life when possible.

Application development for connecting holders and service providers in the form of 2-week sprints. 

The team is composed of 3 to 4 developers, 1 tech lead, 1 scrum master, 1 UI/UX designer, 1 dev tester and 1 product owner.

context.myCrit:
Mobile application project completed during an internship at Blue Soft Group.
I work on this project following the SCRUM agile methodology in the form of 1 or 2 week sprints.

 Crit is a temporary work company, therefore intended for temporary workers.

Professional energy management project developed in collaboration with the BlueSoft team.

Eurowatt uses a GDO application for the renewable energy park network in Europe. Solar, wind and hydraulic energy. The site is multilingual.

TMA and evolution of a database and business tools dedicated to the development, construction and operation of renewable energy production centers.

The team was composed of 2 to 3 developers and 1 Scrum master.
